title: Engineering Manifesto Rules
description: Machine-readable encoding of the Evolith Engineering Manifesto principles. SOLID, DRY, KISS, YAGNI, and anti-pattern rules enforced via linting and review.

antiPatterns.name: God Class / Object
antiPatterns.description: Class with too many responsibilities (> 500 lines, > 20 methods). Violates SRP.

antiPatterns.name: Circular Dependency
antiPatterns.description: Module A imports Module B which imports Module A directly or indirectly.

antiPatterns.name: Shotgun Surgery
antiPatterns.description: One change requires modifying many different classes across the codebase.

antiPatterns.name: Spaghetti Code
antiPatterns.description: Code with complex nested control structures, no clear structure, tangled logic.
antiPatterns.detection: High cyclomatic complexity + low cohesion metrics

antiPatterns.name: Magic Numbers/Strings
antiPatterns.description: Unnamed constants scattered throughout code instead of named constants.

exitCriteria.description: All SOLID violations blocked in CI. DRY violations detected and fixed. Anti-patterns flagged in code review.

rules.title: Single Responsibility: one reason to change
rules.description: Every class and module has one, and only one, reason to change. No God classes or multipurpose utilities.
rules.validationQuery: ESLint rule max-classes-per-file or equivalent. Class length < 200 lines.

rules.title: Open/Closed: open for extension, closed for modification
rules.description: Software entities (classes, modules, functions) are open for extension but closed for modification. New behavior added via inheritance/composition, not by editing existing code.
rules.validationQuery: Code review verifies no modification of tested/approved classes for new features. Extension via polymorphism preferred.

rules.title: Liskov Substitution: subtype substitutable for base
rules.description: Objects of a superclass shall be replaceable with objects of a subclass without affecting correctness. No违背 Liskov anywhere.
rules.validationQuery: TypeScript: no unsafe casting. Liskov violations detected via type checking and test coverage.

rules.title: Interface Segregation: fine-grained interfaces
rules.description: Clients should not be forced to depend on interfaces they do not use. Prefer many small interfaces over one large interface.
rules.validationQuery: Interface size checked. No interface with > 10 methods without documented justification.

rules.title: Dependency Inversion: depend on abstractions
rules.description: High-level modules must not depend on low-level modules. Both must depend on abstractions. Abstractions must not depend on details.
rules.validationQuery: Dependency direction validated via eslint-plugin-boundaries. Core has no Infrastructure imports.

rules.title: Don't Repeat Yourself
rules.description: Every piece of knowledge must have a single, unambiguous, authoritative representation within a system. Duplicated logic must be extracted to a single source.
rules.validationQuery: AST analysis detects duplicated code blocks > 5 lines. ESLint no-duplicate-imports or equivalent.

rules.title: Configuration not duplicated
rules.description: Configuration values (strings, numbers, URLs) must not be hardcoded in multiple places. Centralized config or constants.
rules.validationQuery: Magic numbers/strings detected. Configuration centralized in config files or env vars.

rules.title: Keep It Simple, Stupid
rules.description: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication. Prefer simple solutions over complex ones. Complexity is the enemy of reliability.
rules.validationQuery: Cyclomatic complexity < 15 per method/function. Nested ternaries and complex conditions flagged.

rules.title: Avoid premature abstraction
rules.description: Do not abstract for hypothetical future reuse. Abstract when duplication appears, not before.
rules.validationQuery: Unused interfaces or abstract classes flagged. Abstraction must have concrete use.

rules.title: You Aren't Gonna Need It
rules.description: Do not implement features or abstractions until they are actually needed. Building for hypothetical futures creates complexity debt.
rules.validationQuery: Code review checks for unused code paths or interfaces with no implementing classes.
